Aggregation2.description: Samples aggregate as a batch total.

AnyIdentity.description:
Either instance identity, as a reference target carries them equally.

The two are still separate types: a common record's own identity is never
an owner instance, and reading one out of a reference does not make it one.

Architecture.description: The processor architectures this inventory admits.

Build.description: The complete applicable Build facts one Evidence Set carries.

BuildConfiguration.description: The effective build settings a measured artifact was produced under.

BuildField.description: The complete applicable Build fields one record reports on.

BuildIdentity.description:
A content binding to an owner's actual Build Observation.

It is not a common record identity, a compiler attestation, or an
executable digest, so the framing that produced the checksum travels with it.

CaseEvidence.description: One measured case as the common Evidence Set carries it.

CaseProjection.description:
Exactly the applicable 026 Case dimensions. No source path, build revision,
clock observation, run/record ID, expected result checksum, or sample value.
Artifact/Target/Release/service-profile and memory-domain fields do not apply
to these six internal duration boundaries and are absent, not guessed.

ClockObservation.description: An actual clock acquisition fact, not a guessed precision or a semantic output.

CommonDomain.description: The two instance domains 026 itself registers.

Concurrency.description: How much concurrency a run actually used, and under which policy.

ConditionalObservation.description:
One observation that can also be inapplicable under a registered rule.

Inapplicable is not a third spelling of absent: it names the rule that makes
the field meaningless for this subject.

ConditionalObservation2.description:

Detail.description: The typed payload of a reason.

EnvironmentField.description: Declaration order is the exact 026 environment registry order, not alphabetic.

EvidenceKind.description: The Measurement Evidence Set record kind.

Execution.description: The complete execution state of one measured case.

Instrumentation.description: What a harness installed while measuring, and what it did not.

InvocationFailure.description: How exactly a measured invocation failed.

LockContent.description: One complete observation of the dependency lock a subject resolved against.

MissingObservation.description: Why an observation is absent. Absence is never reported as a value.

NestedReference.description: One local record inside a named parent record.

OwnerRecordIdentity.description:
One fresh instance identity in a domain an owner registers.

The domain is the owner's, so this crate checks its grammar and its
separation from the common domains, never its meaning.

Reason.description: One complete reason: code, stage, what it affects, and its typed payload.

RecordIdentity.description: One fresh instance identity in a domain this crate registers.

Reference.description: One reference to a complete record or to a local record inside one.

Selector.description: What exactly a reason is about.
